target: the hardened gate compared the STDOUT of tracker_profile, which prints nothing when it fails — so a hardened spec whose profile cannot be resolved reached pr-open with no security review at all
cmd: bash "$FIXTURES/tracker-gates/mkspec.sh" specs 904 reviewing hardened; mkdir -p empty-agents; if TRACKER_AGENTS_DIR=$PWD/empty-agents FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance specs/904-t.md pr-open >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ADVANCED; else echo REFUSED; fi
_note: Uses the existing TRACKER_AGENTS_DIR seam pointed at an EMPTY directory, which is what makes tracker_profile exit 6 with empty stdout. An earlier version of this case left the real agents/ dir in place, so profile resolved fine and the case passed for a reason unrelated to the defect.
